features.heading: Eliminate the stress of managing coursework

cards.title: Track, Organize, and Keep Up
cards.body: From dedicated study blocks to push notifications that remind you of coursework and commitments, CourseCadence eliminates the need to juggle multiple syllabi and course calendars. Just open the app to know exactly what you need to do to keep up and stay on track.

cards.title: Say Hello to Your Personalized College Companion
cards.body: Think of CourseCadence as your academic assistant. Push notifications remind you of study sessions and deadlines. It checks in. It even cheers you on. It ensures you never feel like you're navigating college on your own.

cards.title: Better Manage Responsibilities
cards.body: Juggling multiple courses, jobs, and personal obligations is a challenge. You can personalize CourseCadence's time and study management plan to accommodate all of it. You'll better regulate college life and enforce boundaries that promote manageable schedules and workloads for optimal academic outcomes.
